about: Further insights from WMO's press release on the State of the Climate Update 2026 (9 November 2026), already a source on Signals for its headline figures (checked in data/inbox/2026-11-signals-cop31-2). This batch checks only the terms the new points rest on: India's April 2026 heat exposure, the growth in multi-hazard early warning systems, and WHO's first classification of El Nino's anticipated health impacts as a health emergency. What was held back is in ledger.md.

sources.title: State of the climate in 2026 gives new meaning to phrase 'off the charts'

claims.text: An estimated 146.5 million people in India were exposed to extreme heat in an April 2026 heatwave.
Countries reporting multi-hazard early warning systems rose from 56 in 2015 to 136 in 2025.
WHO has, for the first time, classified the anticipated health impacts of El Nino as a health emergency.
